page.overview:
What is Stoutland?

Stoutland is a bulky quadrupedal canine Pokémon. It is particularly fluffy, long-haired, and plump. Its long, thick fur is mostly blue in color with some brown patches. It has a very long "mustache", and a blue cloak of fur over its stout body (which swells slightly towards its rump) and tail. It has small paws and large ears on the top of its head. Also just like Herdier, it too has forehead hair in the shape of a "W". Its back is slightly humped (likely due to the great amount of blubber it likely possesses), with its highest point being towards the center of its back. It resembles a fat Yorkshire Terrier.

A shiny Stoutland's "moustache" (as well as its eyebrows) has a golden tint. Its back fur is now a deep greenish-blue and its bottom fur has a much darker shade of gray.

Stoutland has been known to rescue stranded humans on snowy mountains. Its thick fur acts as a natural insulator that keeps out the cold; Stoutland doesn't tolerate tropical climates very well since the intense heat makes it much sluggish and uncomfortable.

Because of its trustworthy and loyal disposition, Stoutland is often used for rescue teams. Even after being caught in the wild, Stoutland will immediately warm up to its human companion within three days. Social standing is determined by the length of a Stoutland's mustache.
